name: dsh-visible-ssh-engine-win32-x64
description: The compiled visible-ssh engine for win32-x64: visible-ssh.exe plus the two helpers it looks for in its own directory. The executables are built by the engine project (omnibus, product vssh) and deliberately not kept in git; only this manifest, README.md and engine.lock are versioned. The dsh-visible-ssh plugin resolves this package by name and checks the payload against engine.lock before running it.
